lines.text: Two days later...
To cover up the disappearance of Missilis's second CEO, Enme,
the inauguration of his successor is held all the more lavishly, before a gathering of prominent political and business figures.

lines.speaker: femaleexecutive
lines.text: Miss Syuen, listen carefully.

lines.speaker: femaleexecutive
lines.text: If not for yourself, then do it for Mr. Enme who believed in you enough to entrust you with the CEO position before he departed.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Father... believed in me?

lines.speaker: femaleexecutive
lines.text: Of course. Why else would he send Miss Jien packing off to M.M.R.,

lines.speaker: femaleexecutive
lines.text: and appoint you as CEO?

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: That's true, but...

lines.speaker: femaleexecutive
lines.text: So, for Mr. Enme's sake if nothing else, you must not tremble up on that podium.

lines.speaker: femaleexecutive
lines.text: You have to carry yourself with the dignity befitting a CEO.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: For Father's sake...

lines.speaker: femaleexecutive
lines.text: From this moment on, you are the CEO of the great Missilis Industry.

lines.speaker: femaleexecutive
lines.text: You must prove that Mr. Enme was not mistaken in his assessment of you.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Prove that Father wasn't wrong...

lines.speaker: femaleexecutive
lines.text: You understand what I mean, don't you?

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Y-yes... I understand. Don't worry...

lines.speaker: femaleexecutive
lines.text: ... That doesn't sound reassuring.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Um... do you know where Maxwell is, by any chance?

lines.speaker: femaleexecutive
lines.text: The chief engineer has apparently been holed up in her lab since yesterday.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: In her lab...?

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Then... she's not coming?

lines.speaker: femaleexecutive
lines.text: Who's to say. She'll come if she has the time, if not, she won't.

lines.speaker: femaleexecutive
lines.text: Attendance isn't mandatory for researchers, after all.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: I... see.

lines.speaker: femaleexecutive
lines.text: All right, Miss Syuen, it's time.

lines.speaker: femaleexecutive
lines.text: Remember everything I said.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: ... Got it.
Syuen steps up onto the podium.
*Clap, clap, clap*
Syuen wants nothing more than to step down from the podium.
Every part of her wants to give up the CEO position right then and there.
She turns her eyes downward.
The board members are watching her.
The female board executive mouths something silently.
"Mis-ter En-me."
Syuen turns her head toward the prompter.
And then, steadying her trembling hands, she begins her speech.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: T-to... to all the distinguished guests who have joined us.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: I-I-I am Syuen, the new CEO of M-Missilis. It is an honor to meet you all today.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: In accordance with the wishes of the second CEO, my father, Mr. Enme,

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: I... Syuen, will from this day take f-full charge of all Missilis's operations.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: I-in order to develop technology vital to the advancement of humanity,

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: m-my father is currently conducting secret research deep within M.M.R.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: As it is critical work that cannot afford any undue delays,

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: we ask for your understanding for moving so swiftly, w-without a public announcement.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: But, th-there is no need for concern.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: So as not to tarnish my father's good name, I, Syuen, will lead Missilis in upholding its reputation as the Ark's finest company,

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: and carry on its legacy as the home of the most advanced technology in the Ark.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Th-thank you.
Everyone applauds the remarkably young, diminutive CEO.
Syuen stands in the middle of the banquet hall.

lines.speaker: fancysuitman
lines.text: Oh, Miss Syuen!

lines.speaker: fancysuitman
lines.text: Congratulations on your appointment!

lines.speaker: fancysuitman
lines.text: To think someone so tiny could rise all the way to the CEO's chair.

lines.speaker: fancysuitman
lines.text: You must be one smart cookie.
The man's gaze is filled with contempt.

lines.speaker: glasseswoman2
lines.text: So Missilis is handing over the reins to a new generation.

lines.speaker: glasseswoman2
lines.text: I heard Enme had received Evergreen treatments. I assumed he'd never give up his position, much like Mustang.

lines.speaker: glasseswoman2
lines.text: I wonder whether this will turn out to be a positive development for Missilis.
The woman stares at her, sizing her up.

lines.speaker: hatwoman
lines.text: Goodness me. A child this young becoming the CEO...?

lines.speaker: hatwoman
lines.text: No matter how urgent things were, to leave a whole company to a child...

lines.speaker: hatwoman
lines.text: Mr. Enme really does things his way.
The lady shoots her a look of concern.

lines.speaker: flowergarnishwoman
lines.text: Wow, to be a CEO at that age... how enviable.

lines.speaker: flowergarnishwoman
lines.text: Haha, what could a little tyke like her possibly know?

lines.speaker: flowergarnishwoman
lines.text: So, she only became CEO of one of the Big Three because of nepotism?

lines.speaker: flowergarnishwoman
lines.text: I worry for Missilis's future. I really do.
The woman's eyes are laced with envy.

lines.speaker: carefulman
lines.text: So Enme retires out of the blue, without even showing his face?

lines.speaker: carefulman
lines.text: And then he leaves it all to this little girl?

lines.speaker: carefulman
lines.text: Something's fishy about all this... research or not, I think something's happened to Enme.
The man eyes Syuen suspiciously.
All these eyes on her.
Syuen turns her head away.
There stands a colossal sign emblazoned with the Missilis Industry logo.
Syuen feels the pressure rob the breath from her lungs.
She turns to look back across the banquet hall.
She glances around for a long while, searching for a familiar face...
But neither her father, nor Jien,
nor even Maxwell, are anywhere to be seen.
She's suffocating.

lines.speaker: journalistwoman
lines.text: Miss Syuen, Missilis's new CEO! How are you feeling?
But she smiles.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Wonderful. What more could I ask for?

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Especially on such a joyous day like this.
Averting her eyes from the pressure,
she smiles as though it were the happiest day in her entire life.

lines.speaker: maidnikke
lines.text: Miss Syuen, we've prepared a cake in celebration of your appointment.
Syuen looks at the celebratory cake set out on the table.
Syuen glances at her phone.
Not a single person has reached out to her.

lines.speaker: maidnikke
lines.text: Would you like to eat n—

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Forget it. Everyone out.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: I'll eat when I want to.

lines.speaker: maidnikke
lines.text: At least allow us to set the table for y—

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: I said get out!

lines.speaker: maidnikke
lines.text: O-of course!
The maids all leave.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Phew...
*Scrape*
Syuen sits down alone before the celebratory feast.
She looks across the table.
There is no one seated across from her.
Her mouth contorts.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Haha! Wow... there's so much to eat!

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Everything's laid out just for me!
Syuen drags the cake toward herself.
She takes a heaping forkful...
*Chomp*
... and shoves it into her mouth.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Urgh... what the...! It's good!
*Chomp*
She crams another mouthful in, her lips twisting.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Hic...!
The tears brimming in her eyes spill over.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Urgh!
Syuen takes another forkful of cake,
*Chomp*

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: *Sob* Urgh... Hic!
She forces it into her mouth in desperation,
until every last tear has fallen.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Ugh...! My head...!
Maxwell opens her eyes to find herself in her lab.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I'm in my lab...?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What... how long was I out for?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What day is it?
Maxwell powers on her phone.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: A whole week's gone by?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Then... the inauguration!
*Crash*
Maxwell bolts outside.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: So you've finally decided to show your face.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I'm so sorry I couldn't be there for your inauguration!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I, uh... something came up...!

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Like what?
Maxwell wants very much to tell Syuen everything that her father has done,
but then she remembers just how much Syuen loves him.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Sorry. I got so wrapped up in research the night before...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I ended up collapsing from lack of sleep.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: So you were sick, huh?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: ... Yeah, that's right! I was a little... under the weather.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Are you feeling better?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Of course! Right as rain!

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: ... All right, then that's all that matters.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: As long as you didn't stay away on purpose.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Why would I ever do that? It's your inauguration, of all things...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I'm sorry. I should have been there, no excuses.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: It's fine. Don't worry about it.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Stop dwelling on it... I'll forget about it too.
But from that day on, Syuen never once visits Maxwell's lab again.
And so, several years pass.
